why: manybody-shell-1 found 4D hydrogen-bonded rings strongly cooperative (Hartree-Fock three-body 23% of a Xater ring's binding, 42% of XH3's, against 8% for our water's) and the polarizable field overshooting it 2-4x. Nine more trimers (our water's ring, and the tightest and loosest triples of the field's relaxed 4- and 5-molecule 4D clusters) to fit the field's damping between molecules and to test the fit.
